data: What is the value represented by the darkest blue square in the confusion matrix shown in Figure 3?

The darkest blue square corresponds to the cell with the value 72. This can be verified by checking the color scale on the right side of the figure, which indicates that darker shades of blue represent smaller values. The value 72 is located in the cell where the true label is 'NOT' and the predicted label is 'OFF'. Therefore, the value represented by the darkest blue square is 72.
